verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a general search endpoint plus extract, crawl, map and research endpoints. Nothing shows a topic or category filter or a dedicated endpoint for news, images, or finance. The CLI example `tvly search "latest AI news"` is just a free-text query, not a vertical filter, so it does not count. Vertical filtering is a fair axis for a search API, so absence of evidence is "none", not "na".
